name: swiftorigin
description: 迅源 SwiftOrigin - GitHub / Docker / 包管理器边缘加速代理

scripts.deploy: npm run build && deno deploy --org hotier --app github-docker-proxy --prod
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --experimental-strip-types --test tests/stats.test.ts tests/platform-usage.test.ts tests/shared-cache.test.ts tests/proxy-cache.test.ts tests/proxy-length.test.ts tests/proxy-abort.test.ts
